title: COSI-Lab: Conference Living Lab for Modeling Multi-Perspective Multimodal Social Intention
abstract: arXiv:2607.28649v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: COSI-Lab presents a multimodal multi-sensor dataset of a real interdisciplinary scientific workshop with 32 academics at an international conference. It captures ecologically valid social interactions in a weakly scripted setting consisting of two 30-minute mingling sessions with real professional and social consequences. We argue that intelligent systems could better handle subjective perceptions by modeling their multiplicity not as label noise but as an explainable perspective-driven reasoning process. We focus on the Apparent Intent Inference (AII) problem as determined by ex-situ observers and conceptualize intentions to be independent of the future. translated_title: COSI-Lab：用于建模多视角多模态社会意图的会议生活实验室
translated_abstract: COSI-Lab 提供了一个多模态多传感器数据集，数据采集自一次国际会议上举办的真实跨学科学术研讨会，共有32名学者参与。该数据集在一个弱脚本化的环境中捕捉了具有生态有效性的社会互动，包含两个30分钟的自由交流环节，且这些互动具有真实的职业与社交影响。我们认为，智能系统若要更好地处理主观感知问题，不应将其多样性视为标签噪声，而应将其建模为一种可解释的、由视角驱动的推理过程。我们聚焦于由旁观者决定的表面意图推理问题，并将意图概念化为独立于未来的存在。我们的贡献包括：一种考虑感知者自身解释倾向的全新AII标注流程；对意图叙事在多样性、合理性和依据性方面的定量与定性分析；以及针对AII及相关情境因素的基准任务。
tldr: COSI-Lab 发布了一个真实国际会议跨学科研讨会中32名学者的多模态多传感器数据集，提出将主观感知的多样性建模为可解释的视角驱动推理而非标签噪声，并针对表面意图推理（AII）问题贡献了新颖的标注流程和基准任务。
en_tdlr: COSI-Lab introduces a multimodal multi-sensor dataset from a real interdisciplinary conference workshop with 32 academics, modeling the multiplicity of subjective perceptions as explainable perspective-driven reasoning rather than label noise, and contributing a novel annotation process and benchmark tasks for Apparent Intent Inference (AII).
